GOV-F-004-S24.title: Audit Logging Write API
GOV-F-004-S24.description: Implement internal API/service for emitting audit log entries from GPT, Claude, and system components. Enforce schema validation, append-only guarantees, and automatic hash linkage on write.

GOV-F-004-S25.title: Audit Logging Test Suite
GOV-F-004-S25.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only constraints, schema enforcement, hash chain integrity, and failure handling for malformed or tampered entries.

GOV-F-004-S26.title: System Integration with GPT, Claude, and Safety Services
GOV-F-004-S26.description: Integrate audit logging across tool_router, safety_service, GPT reader, and Brain runner flows to ensure all critical operations (tool use, safety triggers, data access) generate audit entries.
